title: Image generation hits fewer policy blocks
summary:
A maintenance day: fewer policy blocks for two image models, and a README news refresh.

The endpoints for `gpt-image-1-mini` and `gpt-image-1.5` were changed to address content-policy blocks encountered on the previous endpoints.

Latest News now recaps March 10 updates to Claude Sonnet 4.6, `dirtberry`, and two community apps. It also removes an older browser-extension entry.
